title: Bivariate stability with a full left threshold
statement: Let $\Phi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function, and let $B_\rho(\alpha,\beta)$ be the standard Gaussian product measure of the set of $(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2$ for which $\Phi(x)\le\alpha$ and $\Phi(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)\le\beta$. If $-1\le\rho\le1$ and $0\le\beta\le1$, then $B_\rho(1,\beta)=\beta$.
